caption: United States v. Baroni and Kelly; Supreme Court review in Kelly v. United States, 590 U.S. 391 (2020)
citation_line: United States v. Baroni and Kelly; Supreme Court review in Kelly v. United States, 590 U.S. 391 (2020)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Wigenton presided over the Bridgegate trial and entered convictions for wire fraud, federal-program fraud and conspiracy based on the politically motivated George Washington Bridge lane realignment.
qualification_rationale: Bridgegate was a major national political scandal, and the case produced a unanimous Supreme Court decision limiting federal property-fraud prosecutions of state and local political misconduct.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit affirmed the relevant convictions, but the Supreme Court unanimously reversed. It held that the lane realignment was an exercise of regulatory power, not a scheme whose object was to obtain the Port Authority’s money or property; employee labor costs were incidental implementation costs.
